chapter: War years, Goodman and Woody Herman
title: The young small band and its road work
summary: The band's young players were enthusiastic, and they toured Chicago, Rock Island, Detroit, Winnipeg and Toronto.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: That was a wonderful little band, we had fun. Shorty was very young, and Shorty was about 17, I think Eddie was 17 or 18, something like that. Young kids. Aaron was quite young, Hank the Kahout Hoop was very young. But it was a swinging band. We were all enthused about it. It's nice to go from those sort of things in music, when you don't go back and have to do the same thing. When you go to something else that's new and try it.

And they got ideas and you start developing from something like that. But I find if you take six men here and six men there and let them develop they'll be different -looking characters, they'll have a different face -- and each six will look different.
Ca'use the musical will force you to go fortune to go a certain ways.
We did a lot of road work. We went out to Chicago, went out to Rock Island, we went to Detroit, we went to Canada, Winnipeg, we went to Toronto. And we did quite a -- quite a bit of work.
